newsitem.title: USA: Perini unit gets NJ light rail subcontract.
newsitem.headline: Perini unit gets NJ light rail subcontract.

text.p: Perini Corp said on Tuesday that its metropolitan New York division has received a contract to provide design and construction services for the Hudson-Bergen Light Rail Transit System in Bayonne, Jersey City and Hoboken, N.J.

The work will be conducted as part of a joint venture with Slatter Associates of Whitestone, N.Y. The deal, which involves providing services for the civil work and track work related to the system, was valued at $244 million.
Perini said the work will be performed under a subcontract with Raytheon Co unit Raytheon Infrastructure Services Inc of Lyndhurst, N.J.

Raytheon Infrastructure had received a $1.26 billion contract by the New Jersey Transit Corp to design, build, operate and maintain the first phase of the project, a 9.8 mile light rail transit system.
